##### Project general facts

Iconic Tower by Mered is a landmark residential development that embodies contemporary luxury, architectural excellence, and timeless Italian design. Created in collaboration with the world-renowned design house Pininfarina, the project presents an exclusive collection of sophisticated residences where innovation, elegance, and functionality come together in perfect harmony. Every aspect of the tower has been thoughtfully designed to maximize natural light, spaciousness, and refined aesthetics, creating an elevated living experience that reflects the highest standards of modern urban living.

Residents enjoy a premium lifestyle supported by an exceptional range of amenities designed for wellness, relaxation, and everyday comfort. Elegant communal spaces, carefully curated leisure facilities, and thoughtfully designed environments foster a sense of balance and well-being, while the tower's iconic architecture and meticulous attention to detail create a truly distinctive residential destination. Every element has been conceived to provide an atmosphere of sophistication, privacy, and effortless luxury.

The residences are finished with premium-quality materials, showcasing exceptional craftsmanship and contemporary design throughout every interior. Elegant finishes, carefully selected textures, and refined detailing create timeless living spaces that combine beauty with functionality. Kitchens come fully equipped with high-end integrated appliances, delivering both style and performance for modern living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Internet City (DIC) stands as a prominent hub for technology and innovation in the heart of Dubai. Established to foster the growth of the IT industry, DIC has evolved into a dynamic business community that attracts global tech giants, startups, and entrepreneurs.

Strategically located, DIC offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and a supportive ecosystem for companies across the technology spectrum. The free economic zone provides a conducive environment for collaboration, research, and development, making it a vital center for digital transformation.

DIC's vibrant landscape hosts a diverse range of businesses, from multinational corporations to cutting-edge startups, all contributing to Dubai's position as a global technology and innovation hub. With its forward-thinking approach and commitment to fostering technological advancements, Dubai Internet City remains at the forefront of shaping the future of the digital landscape in the region.
